This moment, is a fresh, clean slate.
phrases.finnish: Tämä hetki, on uusi, puhdas taulu.

phrases.english: Paint the world, with your unique colors.

phrases.english: Your imagination, a boundless ocean.

phrases.english: Understanding blooms, slowly, like forest moss.
phrases.finnish: Ymmärrys kukkii, hitaasti, kuin metsän sammal.

phrases.english: Your focus, a sharp axe, clears the path.
Sunshine, on my shoulders, feels like a hug.
This quiet morning, my favorite music.
A good cup of coffee, warms the soul.
Forest whispers, secrets for me.
Watching clouds drift, a peaceful journey.
